_comment: Sample athlete profile for scenario testing. Structured long-term state. Sole writer in the method: the Analyst (pace-analyst). The Vision carries the why; this file carries the plannable data. On a plannable fact, this file is authoritative for the Planner. `sports` lists the athlete's disciplines (one for a mono-sport athlete, three for a triathlete); `fitness` is keyed by discipline. `current_phase` is programme-level (sport-agnostic), so it sits at the top, not inside a discipline.

constraints.value: left knee sensitive to high torque / low cadence

rpe_calibration: tends to under-report effort: an athlete-reported 'moderate' often maps to RPE 7

learned_behaviors.observation: responds badly to two consecutive hard days (elevated fatigue, poor session quality on day 2)
learned_behaviors.rule: never schedule two hard sessions on consecutive days; insert Z1/Z2 or rest between them

learned_behaviors.observation: quality intervals go markedly better in the morning than in the evening
learned_behaviors.rule: prefer scheduling threshold/VO2max sessions in the morning

learned_behaviors.observation: performance and recovery degrade sharply in heat above ~30C
learned_behaviors.rule: reduce or reschedule intensity during heatwaves
